answer: In an agent market trading raven illustrations, umber pigments, and crystal models, each bidding identity must lock 100 tokens in escrow for 30 days before it can submit offers. The contract requires a separate deposit for every identity, so creating 1,000 eligible agents ties up 100,000 tokens for a month. Fake identities remain possible, but each one consumes capital the attacker cannot spend elsewhere during the lock.
